turns.utterance: Complete the following checks: inspect the heat exchanger coil surfaces for dust or scale deposits, check the coolant pump outlet pressure against the rated value, and verify all coolant nozzles are unobstructed and correctly directed.

turns.utterance: Shut off coolant flow and remove each nozzle from the manifold. Hold each nozzle against a light source and inspect the orifice for swarf blockage or mineral deposits. ground_truth.node_text: Shut off coolant flow and remove each nozzle from the manifold. Hold each nozzle against a light source and inspect the orifice for swarf blockage or mineral deposits. Blocked nozzles should be soaked in descaler for 10 minutes then cleared with a wire of the correct gauge. Replace nozzles where the orifice shows erosion or enlargement beyond the nominal drill size.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've removed and inspected all nozzles against a light source. Checked each orifice for blockages and erosion.

ground_truth.node_text: Shut off coolant flow and remove each nozzle from the manifold. Hold each nozzle against a light source and inspect the orifice for swarf blockage or mineral deposits. turns.utterance: Use a clean dipstick or graduated probe to measure the depth of settled sediment at three points in the sump: near the pump inlet, at the centre, and at the far end from the pump. Record the maximum reading and compare against the maximum permitted sediment depth.

ground_truth.node_text: Use a clean dipstick or graduated probe to measure the depth of settled sediment at three points in the sump: near the pump inlet, at the centre, and at the far end from the pump. turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Sediment depth measured at all three points. Maximum reading recorded and compared to the schedule.

ground_truth.node_text: Use a clean dipstick or graduated probe to measure the depth of settled sediment at three points in the sump: near the pump inlet, at the centre, and at the far end from the pump.
